name: Powerpoint P06C2MDBL — 60cm Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Powerpoint P06C2MDBL is a 60cm freestanding electric cooker in black with a double cavity — a 69L fan main oven and a 38L top oven/grill — over a four-zone ceramic hob with hot-surface indicators. A black enamel coating wipes clean easily, and it ships with a tip-over safety bracket. A energy rated.
features: Double cavity — 69L fan main oven + 38L top/grill
